<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="2391" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.</tspan>
<tspan x="834.0" dy="16.52">Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.</tspan>
<tspan x="834.0" dy="16.52">Solid edges carry values; dashed edges carry topology, shape or loop state. Library kernels stay opaque.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="2465" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="2495" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="834.0" y="2520" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="834.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.selected_configuration: explicit static module profile; not a runtime observation

sourceFacts: Neighbor sampling, membership-mask normalization and matrix multiplication are source operations; a textbook abstract mean glyph alone would hide these steps.
Both self and neighbor lookups call the SAME externally supplied features callable. Its parameter ownership is unknown at this module boundary.
Encoder owns weight[4,16], with no bias, and multiplies W by combined.t(); output is [4,M], not [M,4].
Selected gcn=False bypasses the source gcn=True set-addition branch. Nonempty neighborhoods are assumed for static shape discussion; division has no epsilon.
Frozen repository has no license file; README is retained and no license is invented.
Graph ranks only allocate space. Explicit edges supply real operands; no upstream code is imported or executed.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
